name: COMP_001
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (60%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged reliability (35%) [F6] and an ambiguous Benign vs InSitu set [F1] require deferring the margin call [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 60%, InSitu 25%, Normal 15%, Invasive 0% | Benign leads; InSitu remains plausible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage, alpha 0.1) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 35% reliability (flagged) / 64% OOD | Suspect input; reduced prediction trust |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (disagree on top class) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 (20%) Benign; 4/5 (80%) Normal [F5] | Nearest neighbors favor Normal tissue |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.47 (-0.99) [F2]; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score 0.10 (-0.46) pushes against invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score 1.34 (-0.37) favors non-invasive glands [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.16 (-0.36) supports non-invasive stroma · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 3, 6) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.31 (-0.35) separates case from Normal · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197), validating heatmap faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion overlaps zero (0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064), and top concept normal_lobules (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- In situ carcinoma (25% probability) is present in duct-confined regions 2, 3, or 6 or deeper levels.
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts caused low reliability (35%) and model disagreement while 4/5 similar cases are Normal.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 6**: Check duct-confined atypia and region 3 lymphocytes for InSitu; consider drafted deeper levels.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 11**: Verify lobules directly (Unreliable 0/20 concept) and inspect slight risk in 0, 11.
3. **Regions 5, 8, 9, 10**: Confirm benign tubules and stroma; consider drafted recut H&E and deferring margins.
